title: MEENA (PersianMMMU): Multimodal-Multilingual Educational Exams for N-level Assessment

task.subset_rule: paper-defined split: the bilingual English subset (3,067 questions: 547 online-sourced + 2,520 Pellekan Yadgiri), zero-shot with image
task.approximation: Answer extraction falls back to an undated gpt-4o-mini judge (paper Sec. 4.3) when the regex stage fails; decoding parameters assumed.

items.source: raia-center/meena (gated, manual approval; CC-BY-ND-4.0); code at https://github.com/raia-center/meena

prompt.source_location: Appendix E, 'English Zero-Shot and Wrong-Image Prompt'
prompt.verbatim: full (the printed template lists the choice numbers 1)-4) with the option texts filled from the item)

output.parse: regex stage: patterns such as 'correct answer is option (\d)' / 'answer[: ]+(\d)' -> option 1-4; fallback judge: gpt-4o-mini with the Appendix E 'LLM as a Judge (Answer Extraction)' prompt returning 1-4 / no_image / cannot_understand / wrong_image / unknown
output.postprocess: strip; non-numeric outcomes counted as incorrect

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: share of the 3,067 English questions whose extracted option equals the gold option.
metric.judge: llm:gpt-4o-mini (answer extraction fallback only), prompt location Appendix E 'LLM as a Judge (Answer Extraction)'
metric.original_location: Table 2, MEENA English Dataset, row GPT-4-Turbo, column Zero Shot (0.440)

open_points: Request access to the gated raia-center/meena dataset (manual approval) and confirm that its licence (CC-BY-ND-4.0) permits the run; field names cannot be checked before access.
Confirm that the 'MEENA English Dataset' rows of Table 2 cover all 3,067 bilingual questions (n is not printed).
notes: Image inputs make each call ~1k tokens. The gpt-4o-mini fallback snapshot is undated in the paper.
